reference.note: toolbox sources are not copied into this repository

structure.QNR_D_lambda_D_s: same as Toolbox 1.0 (flag_orig_paper=0): full-resolution 32x32 UQI blocks, D_lambda vs LMS band pairs, D_s vs interp23tap(imresize(PAN,1/4)); p=q=1
structure.interp23tap: same insertion phase, circular boundary and coefficients

Q2n_onion_multiplication.finding: common/metrics._onion differs from onion_mult.m for 4 and 8 bands (max element difference 12.3 and 18.3 on random vectors)

FR_D_s_PAN_downsampling.finding: scikit-image resize(order=3, anti_aliasing) instead of MATLAB imresize bicubic antialias
FR_D_s_PAN_downsampling.interpretation: Q_low depends only on inputs; |delta D_s| per scene-band is bounded by |delta Q_low|; model differences are unchanged when Q_high values lie on the same side of Q_low
FR_D_s_PAN_downsampling.caveat: MATLAB imresize reproduced from its documented algorithm in Python; not bit-verified against MATLAB

differences.output_clipping: toolbox clips to [0, 2^L] when th_values=1; repository evaluation does not clip; calling script not checked
differences.reported_index: toolbox also provides HQNR (D_lambda_K with MTF and Q2n); which index the SSA-MRN paper used was not checked

conclusion: implementation differences cannot explain the perf29 W2 D_s gap (0.146 vs 0.039); small D_s differences (< ~0.01) need care
